status.description: done = package built AND the gate passed; needs_input = one user decision is missing; failed = blocked, say why

summary.description: 2-5 plain-language sentences for the trader: what was built and how it behaves, or what is blocking

question.description: needs_input only: exactly one question for the user

options.description: needs_input only: concrete choices, if any

why.description: needs_input only: why the spec does not already answer it

stage_lines.description: copied verbatim from the gate output, e.g. '✓ static'

warnings.description: advisory lint warnings the user must hear, verbatim

exit_preview.description: the DSL ladder as outcomes in price terms at the chosen leverage

blocking_finding.description: failed only: the finding that blocks, in its own words
